identity.message: Potential server-side request forgery due to a [user-provided value](1).

findings.justification: The complete request URI is prefixed with the operator-configured Agent origin. Real two-origin HTTP regressions prove hostile paths/queries retain that origin and both proxy overloads do not follow cross-origin redirects or disclose the Bearer token. Applies only to these exact source and test bytes.

identity.message: CSRF vulnerability due to protection being disabled.

findings.justification: The actual SecurityConfig accepts JWT credentials only from an explicit Authorization header. RSA/Nimbus verified regressions show cookies, authenticated sessions, query and form credentials cannot authorize a mutation; a header-authorized request creates no authentication session. Applies only to this exact authentication configuration.
